styleLock.direction: clean modern task-lighting commerce with a red accent system
styleLock.backgroundSystem: three fixed backdrops used consistently: seamless #FFFFFF packshot, matte #2E3134 hero and ambience panel, warm light-grey #F3F1EC info panels, with a matte wood desk #D9C7A7 only in the desk scenes
styleLock.lightingSystem: soft large-source studio key from front-left with fill and soft contact shadows, consistent direction across the set; the product's own diffuser glow reads #F2B341 and is the only warm in-frame source, except in the light-mode variant row where each panel is hex-pinned
styleLock.surfaceSystem: matte board #F3F1EC and matte wood desk top #D9C7A7, both with soft diffuse reflectance and no mirror speculars
styleLock.typography: modern geometric sans-serif headlines, Chinese in-image text always wrapped in 「」, no dense body copy; headline 28-48pt, label 10-14pt
styleLock.iconSystem: thin-line icons and numbered circular mode badges, single red accent #C62828, uniform stroke weight
styleLock.presentationRules: stable product scale and stable base contact with a soft contact shadow in every shot; the round diffuser head always reads as a single circle, the neck keeps its smooth curve, and glow color stays #F2B341 unless a mode variant is being shown
noDrift: no warped straight lines or deformed product geometry
styleLock.lockText: consistent clean modern task-lighting e-commerce visual system across the entire image set; fixed palette of seamless packshot #FFFFFF, warm light-grey info panels #F3F1EC, charcoal framing and text #2E3134, warm diffuser glow #F2B341 and one red accent #C62828; neutral studio temperature; soft large-source front-left key light with fill and soft contact shadows; matte board and matte wood desk surfaces; modern geometric sans-serif headlines with Chinese in-image text wrapped in 「」; consistent thin-line icons and numbered circular badges; stable product scale, stable base contact and single-circle diffuser head; no color palette changes, no mixed fonts, no random backgrounds, no inconsistent lighting, no mismatched icon styles, no warped straight lines or deformed product geometry.

provenance.notes: 8 屏台灯详情长图切片提炼。已剥离：原品牌字与红底 Logo、'2021 设计奖' 等原文案，'5小时/1200毫安/20000+循环/20cm/30cm*60cm/220V/5W/1800毫安/400g' 等数值（改为 {callout_n} 占位），儿童模特实拍与模糊人脸、二维码店铺贴图、原始排版与水印式大字。产品一律以 {product} 占位；品类按源图自身标注「产品类型：家用电器」，taxonomy 家用电器下无照明 L2，归入最贴近的 环境电器。
